question: What is the unmanifest sign described in this state?
premises: Its nature consists of man, power, and Śiva.
In it this universe is dissolved and it is understood as standing within.
inference: The unmanifest sign is the triadic ground of man, power, and Śiva in which the universe is inwardly dissolved.
plain_english: This is the unmanifest sign, whose nature is man, power, and Śiva, in which this whole universe is dissolved and which is understood as present within.
